en:
"*Cough, hack*...{w}As you can see, I'm an invalid... *cough*.{w}And yet they claimed I was faking it to slack off... *hack*"{w}{p}"...Even if I were faking, don't you think
throwing me in jail is cruel?"{w}
note: Speaker name box (row 1262, slice_015) = byoujaku na kenkaku, "sickly swordsman". byounin rendered "invalid" to avoid gendering ("sick man").

en: There are old documents and history books here.{w}

There are old documents and history books here.
You found something among them.{w}

[Key Item]
Obtained Sun Prison Shrine.{w}
note: New item: Sun Prison Shrine (zushi = small shrine cabinet; "you lot" opens it and a doll is inside). ITEM_PRIZ max 18; 17 chars.

en:
When you opened the Sun Prison Shrine,
a small fairy doll came out from inside.{w}{p}It looked as if someone had made it by hand.{w}You gently put the doll back in its box.{w}
Summer
note: Ninja rank/monster name (katakana samaa; MON_TEXT: "a ninja holding the title of Samaa"). Romanized as Summer; tentative.

en:
"If you find a log lying in the forest,{w}it may be the trace of a ninja
who used the Substitution Technique..."{w}
note: kawarimi no jutsu = Substitution Technique (ninja swaps self for a log).

en: Kannagi
note: Monster name (shrine-medium type), romanized.

en: "Truth is, if you peel back that wall, behind it{w}the whole surface is plastered with talismans...{w}Hmm, whatever happened here long ago?"{w}
Tenko
note: Monster name tenko (celestial fox), romanized like Kannagi/Hatamoto. Alternative: "Celestial Fox".

en: "Yes, this place is a fine one to dwell in after all.{w}Other lands are noisy somehow -- it simply won't do.{w}A den ought to be quiet."{w}
Hatamoto
note: Monster name (samurai banner-bearer), romanized.

en: "My katana's gone rusty..."{w}
"You haven't been looking after it properly, have you?{w}Better that than if it were a Muramasa, right?"{w}
note: Muramasa = the famous katana item. Kannagi teases Hatamoto: at least the rusted blade was not a Muramasa.

en:
"...Like a Muramasa would ever turn up.{w}How many dozens of hours have I spent hunting for one...?"{w}{p}"If only I could use a spear one-handed,
things might be a little better.{w}...Wait, you can?"{w}
note: Meta joke about farming the Muramasa drop. Last line: someone (unseen) tells him spears can be one-handed; kept as "Wait, you can?".

en: Asunamuchi
note: New name (10 dupes). Romanized literally; possibly modeled on Onamuchi. Glossary gender unknown; speech uses archaic feminine "warawa" but no pronouns used for her.

Source title is ten-jou ma-ryoku (green), almost certainly a typo for ma-en (fiend/devil) as in ITEM_PRIZ 26:4 "Tenjou Maen Asunamuchi"; translated "the Heavenly Fiend". Between pages the party evidently fails to introduce itself. daichi no tami = "folk of the land" (daichi = "the land" per pilot). Archaic-noble register for her throughout.
Miasuna = castle/dungeon name (written with kanji + ruby "Miasuna"; DGN_NAME uses katakana Miasuna). Ruby dropped.

en: "............By the way.{w}Lately there has been some racket outside..........."{w}{p}"You lot, go and have a look for me.{w}I shall wait here at my leisure.{w}I expect something amusing, mind."{w}
note: "tokini" (written with the kanji for time) read as "by the way".

en: "...How long do you mean to keep me waiting? Make haste.{w}The land will perish at this rate, you know?{w}Ohohohohoho!"{w}

"Ohohohoho!{w}Alive! They're alive!
These ones actually came back alive!"{w}{p}"Well?{w}Tell me all of it, from beginning to end."{w}
You told Asunamuchi about the whole affair.{w}

"Truly, truly? Is that so?{w}Ohohohohoho!"{w}{p}"Who'd have thought it -- mere people of the land!
My, how hard you strove!
You went beyond my every expectation!"{w}{p}"Yes, this is just how amusement
ought to be.{w}When one can see through everything, it is so dull."{w}{p}"Ohohohohohohoho!{w}I have not laughed like this in ages,
ohohohohohohoho!"{w}{p}"Mm, I am satisfied.
You may withdraw now."{w}

note: "aite wo sei" = be my partner/opponent; it leads to a fight, so "play with me" keeps both the idle and the menacing reading. Paired with choice row 1287.

en: Play with Asunamuchi?
note: Choice prompt (aite wo shimasu ka). Named instead of "her" (gender not in glossary). 21 chars.

en: "Ohohohoho!!{w}What a spirited reply -- splendid indeed.{w}Don't you lot go dying on me too soon, now."{w}

"Ohohohoho!{w}Delightful! Truly delightful!"{w}{p}"You lot are about the only ones
who have ever amused me this much.{w}Ohohohoho!!"{w}
note: Presumably after the party wins the fight.

en: "Is that so...{w}How truly... dull..."{w}
note: Refusal branch.

en: Evil Magistrate
note: akudaikan, the stock corrupt magistrate of period dramas. 15 chars.

en:
"...Who goes there?{w}Were you drawn here by the scent
of these golden 'sweets' of mine?"{w}{p}"What? You've come to bring me to justice?{w}Amusing... All of you! Intruders!{w}Cut them down! Cut them to pieces!!"{w}
note: yamabuki-iro no okashi = the period-drama bribe: gold coins hidden in a box of sweets. Quotes around 'sweets' signal the euphemism.

en: "You may have beaten me, but it's already too late...{w}Heh heh heh heh...{w}
note: Source has no closing quote here (row 1294 continues the same line); kept unclosed.
{0E}..{0F} re-shows row 1293 text verbatim.

en: You brought the Evil Magistrate to justice!{w}{p}But your joy was short-lived --{w}you sensed some kind of evil presence.{w}{p}The presence vanished in an instant,{w}leaving only an eerie silence behind.{w}
Jailer
"You there! What are you doing!?"{w}
"Curse you, you lowly curs!!{w}But I'll tolerate no lawlessness here in Meiroin!!{w}Begone!!"{w}
note: Meirouin = Miasuna dungeon section (DGN_NAME "Miasuna Meirouin"); it is the prison block, so "Meirou Prison". New term, tentative.

en: Samurai
"Intruuuuders!{w}Suspicious rogues! Seize theeeem!!"{w}

Without a sound, a ninja appeared before you.{w}Ninja: a band of assassins originating in the East,
whose every inch is said to be a weapon.{w}{p}Make one careless move or let your gaze wander,
and your head could easily go flying.{w}{p}But you, too, are seasoned adventurers.{w}Gauging each other's strength,
you inch closer, closing the distance.{w}{p}The breathless standoff continues.{w}The moment either side's breathing falters,
the fight will begin.{w}{p}............{w}
note: Kept the source shift into the present tense for the standoff.

en: Ninja

note: Build-up to the sneeze in 1304.

en: "...AH-CHOOOOOO!!"{w}

note: i-ma-da ("now!") spelled out syllable by syllable; narration urging the party to strike.

en: A flower made of crystal is blooming here.{w}
A flower made of crystal is blooming here.{w}
note: Same text as 1306 (source only drops the final period).

en:
[Key Item]
Obtained Crystal Flower.{w}
note: Crystal Flower as in wmap slice_06 (Zeppo quest).

en: The crystal here is a different color from the rest.{w}
Beyond the thick fog, you sensed someone's presence.{w}The presence took human shape and slowly drew closer.{w}
Stay where you are?

The thing drawing closer, step by step,
had much the same build as you.{w}{p}Much the same?{w}{p}No -- what had appeared was you yourselves.{p}
note: Source ends with {p} not preceded by {w}; kept as is. Doppelganger encounter (EVENT_TEXT 43:8).

en:
With a bitter aftertaste,
you left that place.{w}
Something is lying here.{w}

[Key Item]
Obtained Vision Crystal.{w}
note: New item genshi no kesshou = Vision Crystal (material for the observatory, Mayleen event). 14 chars.

en: You left that place.{w}

A mysterious girl appeared before you.{w}Perhaps this was her usual route -- even on seeing you,
she kept coming without the slightest hesitation.{w}{p}When she was right in front of you, the girl knit her brows
as though it were all a great nuisance,
and made a small brushing-away gesture with her hand.{w}
note: shoujo = girl (gender given by source). EVENT_TEXT 39:8 mentions a short blue-haired girl deep in the Crystal Labyrinth; identity not stated here, left as "girl".

en: "...Move. You're in the way."{w}
Step aside?

When you made way,
the girl walked off as if nothing had happened.{w}

When you held your ground and refused to make way,
the girl gave a small sigh.{w}
"...Honestly."{w}

As though shooing away a dog,
the girl waved her hand at you: shoo, shoo.{w}{p}You fled for your lives.{w}
note: "at you" added for clarity; the gesture plainly targets the party.
Presumably after the party beats her. majutsushi = Mage (glossary). The stretched "yooku" rendered as a pause.

en:
The girl's eyes gleamed.
Your bodies floated up into the air, and then...{w}

In a cave filled with light,
a strange skull was flying through the air.{w}{p}Its pure-white wings somehow called light itself to mind.{w}The noble, radiant winged skull, seemingly not of this world,
flitted through the air, scattering motes of light.{w}{p}Bone though it was,
its shining white form gave off not a trace of malice.{w}If anything, it even exuded a holy air.{w}

"Ugh, what a draaag, maaan...{w}We could just leave Zaalhaut alone,
couldn't we? Jeez~"{w}
The holy air was just your imagination.{w}

"Even after getting the Beldoll,
Zaalhaut never answered the call in the first place, right?"{w}{p}"And far from answering -- tossing away one of the
strongest Arguments there is? That's nuts.
Just what you'd expect from Zanu's daughter."{w}{p}"Sure, like the report said, it looks like
the Beldoll's been revived in Finas Rade, but..."{w}{p}"I really can't see Zaalhaut trying anything
on us at this point... Huh?"{w}
note: Subject of "never answered" and "do anything to us" omitted in source; restored as Zaalhaut (topic of the previous row; the skull is looking for Zaalhaut). "Zanuu's daughter" may therefore refer to Zaalhaut -- no pronoun used. Beldoll = seichirin Beldoll, an Argument (MON_TEXT 316); Argument = seisengu (selection relic for the Librarian). "the call" = the Argument summoning its bearer to the Mechanism.

en: The weird bone noticed you.{w}
"Yo! Is Zaalhaut anywhere around...{w}Ah, crap!{w}I wasn't supposed to talk to anybody!!"{w}
The weird bone is panicking all by itself.{w}

"Ohhh, wh-what do I do?
Lord Hevayur's gonna chew me ouuut!{w}Hey, you! What am I supposed to... do!?"{w}
note: Source has Hevayur-sama; honorific dropped because Lord/Lady would need a gender not in the glossary (MON_TEXT 324 calls Hevayur a man -- if accepted, "Lord Hevayur" restores the deference).

en: There's nothing in particular you can do to help.{w}

"Nngh... Th-then I've got no choice
but to... wipe you out!!{w}Sorry, I'm so sorryyy!!"{w}
"Ow! That hurts, you bastard!!{w}You'll pay for this, dammit!!"{w}
The weird bone ran off.{w}
Some worn-out old junk has been left here.{w}
Some worn-out old junk has been left here.{w}Looking closely, you see it is labeled Proof of Endurance.{w}
note: New item nintai no akashi = Proof of Endurance (18 chars, ITEM_PRIZ max 18).

en: Swap for Proof of Training?
note: New item tanren no akashi = Proof of Training. 27 chars.

en: You set down the Proof of Training.{w}

[Key Item]
Obtained Proof of Endurance.{w}
